decisions.reason: As a core airfield lighting control product built on established capabilities, its uncertainty is limited and the cost of keeping the option open is low, so the firm retains it.
This surveillance display complements the firm's portfolio and still has unresolved market prospects, while its keeping costs are moderate, justifying continued option value.
The training program is a service option with moderate keeping costs and pandemic-related demand uncertainty, but it remains a viable option as airports recover.
Although peripheral and only briefly mentioned on the website, this training course is a very low-cost option that can be kept open with negligible resources until demand signals clarify.
The collaboration software aligns with the firm's strategic move toward integrated intelligent airport operations, and its high option value outweighs the uncertainty and keeping costs.
This advanced MLAT system has higher technical and market uncertainty, but its strategic importance for surveillance leads the firm to keep the option open despite higher keeping costs.
